messages.text:
The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Removed the synthesized match and win tones from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts). Matching still updates the game normally, including its announcements and visual completion state, as required by the project’s silent sound rules.

A source search found no remaining audio playback APIs in shipped source. I didn’t run the test suite.
